origin.description: Lazy pipe variant, meant to be assigned to an infix symbol.

arguments.name: lhs
arguments.text: A value, or the dot placeholder.

arguments.name: rhs
arguments.text: A function or a call, using the same placement rules as %>%.

origin.details: This is the evaluation used by %>%. Each step's result is a promise. A function body runs before that promise is forced, so messages print from the last step backward, and a step that never uses its argument leaves the earlier steps unevaluated.
origin.value: The result of the chain, or a function when the left-hand side is the dot.

translation.description: Lazy pipe with the same observable result as pipe.

arguments.name: lhs
arguments.text: The starting value, or DOT to return a functional sequence.

arguments.name: steps
arguments.text: The same callable and (function, args, kwargs) steps as pipe.

translation.details: The last step runs first and receives a delayed value. Side effects of earlier steps run when that value is used, from the last step backward. A pure chain matches pipe.
translation.value: The piped value, or an FSeq when lhs is DOT.
translation.example:
from magrittr.pipe import pipe_lazy_masking
pipe_lazy_masking(list(range(1, 11)), sum)
